newsitem.title: USA: Golden Poultry in Gold Kist merger talks.
newsitem.headline: Golden Poultry in Gold Kist merger talks.

text.p: Gold Kist Inc, an agricultural cooperative, said Thursday it started merger talks with Golden Poultry Co Inc.
Gold Kist said it currently owns about 10.9 million, or 75 percent, of Golden Poultry's 14.6 million shares of common stock.
Gold Kist said results of the negotiations would have to be submitted to its board before a decision could be made about completing the deal.
If an acquisition is completed, Golden Poultry would functio as a cooperative, Gold Kist said.
Golden Poultry's fiscal 1996 sales totaled $600.2 million, while Gold Kist reported fiscal 1996 sales of $2.0 billion.
